Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin currency/CPI skill with the generalizable gotcha:

For Nov. 1969 currency in circulation, the correct nominal Treasury value is about 52,941 million; 52,991 million is the wrong adjacent/non-circulation figure and produces the too-high 56,170.5 result after applying 6.0% CPI-U.

Also updated memory compactly to preserve the distinction for future runs.
